explication: Mailflare is a self-hosted custom-domain email inbox. A user connects a domain, configures routing, creates mailboxes, then reads, organizes, imports, or sends mail through the dashboard and API. Incoming mail is delivered by Cloudflare Email Routing and processed into mailbox messages; outgoing mail is sent through the configured email service. The README also documents shared access, contacts, spam controls, webhooks, backups, and real-time updates. Sampled routes show database and Cloudflare calls; some feature wiring is based on documented capabilities and the repository tree, not inspected source.
